candidates.source_name: Register účtovných závierok (RÚZ) — public register of financial statements, MF SR
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory central repository of all Slovak accounting units' financial statements and annual reports, including banks and payment institutions. Filings (PDF + structured) are back-filled and preserved even when an issuer removes them from its own site, so it is the backbone for multi-year time-series on SK bank/PSP financials.

candidates.legal_status: open data (public part of the register, reuse permitted)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the register's documented public API / bulk endpoints for automated retrieval by IČO; snapshot PDF annual reports; schedule against the stated weekly refresh cadence

negative_findings.description: No EDGAR-style single full-text, machine-readable filing archive exists for Slovak banks. Disclosure is split between RÚZ (accounting statements), CERI (regulated information from securities issuers) and issuers' own IR pages; none offers EDGAR-like full-text search across all filings.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched sk and en for a consolidated SK filing search engine; found only the three separate silos plus commercial aggregators.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any time-series build must join at least RÚZ + CERI + issuer sites on IČO/LEI; budget for reconciliation rather than expecting one archive.

negative_findings.description: Could not confirm an active 'Cribis Universal Register' product offered for Slovakia by Dun & Bradstreet/Bisnode; search returned only the Bisnode→D&B Slovakia rename (effective 2022) and generic D&B products.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids recording a non-existent SK product line; the CRIF/Cribis family may cover SK under a different brand and needs a dedicated check.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Treat that candidate's URL and bulk availability as unverified until the deterministic liveness pass runs.

negative_findings.description: No established Slovak-language term was found for 'machine-readable mirror' or 'bulk download archive' as a category; practitioners use borrowed English ('SQL dump', 'API', 'dataset') inside Slovak sentences.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact RÚZ public API/bulk endpoints and the ekosystém SQL-dump download URLs were referenced in secondary summaries but their concrete endpoint paths and rate/licence conditions were not read from primary documentation in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch registeruz.sk FAQ/API documentation and ekosystem.slovensko.digital/podmienky directly and record endpoint paths, refresh cadence and licence text.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-specific supervisory reporting archives (NBS prudential/statistical data warehouse, ECB/EBA data portals mirroring SK institution data) were not covered here; they belong to a supervisory cell but are the natural machine-readable complement to corporate filings.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure a sibling cell covers NBS statistical datasets and ECB/EBA data portals for SK credit institutions; cross-link with this cell's entity keys.

coverage_gaps.description: No LEI-to-IČO crosswalk source was identified for SK financial institutions, which is required to join local register data to GLEIF/ECB/EBA datasets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search GLEIF Level-1 records filtered to SK and check whether the local registration authority field carries IČO; build and version the crosswalk.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage depth of Slovak bank IR domains inside Internet Archive and webdepozit.sk was not measured; it is unknown how many withdrawn annual reports are actually recoverable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run CDX API counts per major SK bank domain (PDF paths, IR paths) to quantify recoverability before relying on archives for back-fill.

brief: Slovakia has an unusually strong machine-readable disclosure backbone for a market its size: the statutory Register účtovných závierok publishes company financial statements as open data with API/bulk access, the Register právnických osôb V2 supplies the entity layer, and NBS's CERI archives regulated issuer reports back to June 2007. Aggregation splits into a civic-tech tier (ekosystém.slovensko.digital SQL dumps and APIs mirroring RÚZ, RPO, CRZ and Obchodný vestník) and a commercial tier (FinStat with unified statement templates and bulk CSV/API, FOAF.sk free, D&B Slovakia and Moody's Orbis for cross-border comparability). Archive recovery rests on the Internet Archive CDX API plus the national legal-deposit web archive run by the University Library in Bratislava, which matters because NBS itself has migrated issuer pages into a /historia tree. The main open risks are unverified endpoint/licence detail on the state registers, no EDGAR-style full-text search across SK filings, and no established LEI-to-IČO crosswalk for joining local filings to EU supervisory data.
